scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server:lan" "npm run dev:client:lan"
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.pack:mac: npm run build && npm run build:icon && node scripts/prepare-mac-seed.mjs && node scripts/pack-mac-chrome-app.mjs
scripts.pack:mac:electron: npm run build && npm run build:icon && node scripts/prepare-mac-seed.mjs && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64
scripts.pack:mac:chrome: npm run build && npm run build:icon && node scripts/prepare-mac-seed.mjs && node scripts/pack-mac-chrome-app.mjs
scripts.pack:mac:intel: npm run build && npm run build:icon && node scripts/prepare-mac-seed.mjs && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64
scripts.pack:mac:all: npm run build && npm run build:icon && node scripts/prepare-mac-seed.mjs && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --x64
